messages:
Ashley: Quick heads-up — EdgeBridge wants to onboard NovaEast-2 to the marketplace. Request: 8x A100 reserved + 4x burst. Need quota, KMS entitlement, and cross-account key. Go-live target 2026-04-12. Pinged partner for CI/CD creds.
Matt: Can you paste the exact SKU IDs and expected QPS so I can map to marketplace SKUs?
Ashley: SKUs: EB-NOVA-A100-8, EB-NOVA-A100-BURST-4. Expected steady QPS 180, spike to ~600 QPS for first 3 hrs after launch. Token estimate ~12M/day.
Sanjay: 600 QPS spike is significant — recommend separate burst bucket + explicit scale policy. I’ll open the entitlement ticket. Julia, can you confirm legal & PD terms? @Julia
Julia: On it. Need partner legal contact + explicit data residency confirmation (NovaEast-2 is EU-adjacent). Also flagging encryption-at-rest + key custodianship.
Clara-Partner-Ops: EdgeBridge PM (leah@edgebridge.com) confirmed they’ll use our AWS KMS integration. They’ll provide a cross-account principal and want a peered VPC endpoint.
marketplace-bot: Ticket created: MP-202604-1423 — Entitlement request submitted (8 A100 reserved, 4 A100 burst). ETA for quota approval: 5-7 business days.
Matt: Cool. Add a Dedicated fallback plan to g5.2x for the initial canary to save cost.
Ashley: Runbook draft uploaded: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/edgebridge-novaeast2 — please review.
Sanjay: Suggested autoscale snippet to include in the deployment policy:
```
autoscale:
  min_instances: 2
  max_instances: 32
  target_rps_per_gpu: 60
  burst_bucket: 4
```
Matt: LGTM. I’ll schedule throughput tests with EdgeBridge next Tue.
Julia: Legal sent LOA to partner yesterday; waiting for signature from EdgeBridge legal. Also added data processing appendix for EU-adj region.
Clara-Partner-Ops: I’ll start the KMS cross-account setup and share ARNs. Also requesting partner account number for peering config.
Ashley: Action items noted. Matt to run tests, Sanjay to track MP ticket, Clara to share KMS ARNs, Julia to chase LOA.
Matt: @Clara-Partner-Ops when you add the MP request payload, drop it here so I can validate SKU mapping.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: quota approval cutoff for coordinated launch is 2026-04-05.
Ashley: Noted — I’ll follow up with partner this afternoon. :thumbsup:
Matt: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread for launch-day coordination.
